steps.note: Open the prepared live RFQ with two bids directly on the Responses tab.

Send a counter offer changing Vendor A's normal bid to 90.
Verify the Responses grid marks the counter offer as initiated for Vendor A.
Have Vendor A accept the pending counter offer in the vendor portal.
Verify the buyer-side Responses grid marks Vendor A's counter offer as accepted.
Verify the response panel counts the accepted counter offer.
Open the buyer's Master QCS after acceptance.
Verify Master QCS uses Vendor A's accepted counter price of 90.
